label: WatchGuard Firebox M290 firewall
description: WatchGuard Firebox M290 - mid-range branch firewall: 8x 1GbE RJ45 and no SFP cages as shipped (the open module bay accepts optional 4x1G copper, 4x1G SFP, 2x10G SFP+ or 4-port multispeed modules). Default WAN is eth0, eth1-eth7 are LAN/optional ports.
